# Task: #6712 A1 hub module cards must be real links

## CAPACITY_CARD
pick=cursor Ultra 20x first pick this month
## ROUTING_CARD_V1
task_id: 6712-a1-hub-links
tier: heap
model_x_harness: cursor/auto
owned_paths: site/ packages/  (A1 hub / course map cards only)

## Bug
https://learn-ukrainian.github.io/a1/ — module cards navigate on mouse click but are not `<a>` / link roles. Keyboard and screen readers cannot open a module. In-lesson sidebar links are fine.

## Do
1. Make each module card a real link (`<a href=…>` or equivalent accessible link). Click, Enter, and SR "link" must work.
2. Do not change lesson content. Do not restyle the whole hub.
3. Add/adjust a test if the hub has one; otherwise a small vitest/rtl assertion that cards render as links.
4. Commit `fix(site): A1 hub module cards are real links (#6712)` trailer `X-Agent: cursor/6712-a1-hub-links`. PR. No merge.

I'll start with cold-start, then inspect the A1 hub module cards and make them real accessible links.

Found `ModuleCard` in `LevelLanding.tsx`. Reading it and looking for existing hub tests.

`ModuleCard` already wraps done/active items in `<a>`, but production says they aren't links — checking how A1 is rendered and whether another path overrides that.

Source already wraps cards in `<a>` — checking live HTML and `LiveStatus` for what actually breaks the accessibility tree.

Live HTML already has `<a>` wrappers — checking whether a11y is broken by structure/CSS, and whether the home course-map cards are the real gap.

Production already has `<a>` wrappers (QA confirmed). I'll harden the card markup so the link *is* the card, add a regression test, then commit and open the PR.

Hardening `ModuleCard` so the `<a>` is the card itself, hiding nested status from the accessibility name, and adding a regression test.

**Done.** Hub module cards are now the `<a>` itself (not a styled div wrapped by a bare anchor), with a regression test and PR open — not merged.

### Fix
Production already had `<a>` wrappers, but the card chrome lived on an inner `div` (`cursor: default`), and A1’s `LiveStatus` `role="img"` could steal the accessible name. Changes in `LevelLanding`:

- Available modules render as `<a class="moduleItem moduleLink" href=…>`
- Locked modules stay non-link `<div>`s
- Status icons are `aria-hidden` when linked
- `:focus-visible` ring + pointer cursor on linked cards only

### Test
`site/tests/unit/LevelLanding.test.tsx` — 2 passed (`role=link` + `href`; locked not a link; A1 name is the title)
